title: Kissed Egyptian Tagliatelle Tagine
description: Herb-infused tagliatelle steams in a fragrant Egyptian tagine, topped with melted feta for a cheese-pull finish. A low-carb, adventurous twist on a classic Mediterranean dish.
instructions: Heat olive oil in a tagine or heavy‑bottomed pot over medium heat and sauté the chicken until lightly browned, about 5 minutes.
Add smoked paprika, salt, and pepper, stirring to coat the chicken evenly.
Pour in the chicken broth, bring to a gentle simmer, and add lemon zest, cilantro, and mint, cooking for another 5 minutes.
Add the tagliatelle and transfer the pot to the oven preheated to 180°C (350°F) and bake, covered, for 15 minutes.
Remove the pot and sprinkle crumbled feta over the hot tagliatelle, allowing the cheese to melt into the steam.
Give everything a gentle stir to combine the melted cheese with the herbs and juices.
Serve the dish straight from the tagine, optionally garnishing with extra mint or a squeeze of fresh lemon.
Enjoy the aromatic, low‑carb fusion of Egyptian flavors and tender pasta, with a delightful cheese‑pull finish.
